name: google-news-flashdata
description: Search Google News for articles, publishers, date labels and source links. Turn a topic into a traceable news briefing. Uses the paid FlashData API.

FLASHDATA_API_KEY.title: FlashData API key
FLASHDATA_API_KEY.description: FlashData API key from https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys with google_news enabled. Data calls use paid Credits; pricing and job reads are free.
